comment: Differences between examples/providers/gitlab/fake.js and a real GitLab CE that are known and kept, one entry each: the exact `id` the run prints, the GitLab majors it holds for, and the reason. A difference not listed fails the run; so does an entry that no longer matches anything.

allow.reason: 19.6 answers the device authorization request with `Vary: Accept, X-Requested-With`, where 19.5.1 answered `Vary: Accept`; the fake keeps the 19.5 header, and nothing in the provider or the harness reads it (the harness only compares it).
